items.title: Advanced Micro Devices (AMD) Adds Tim Ryan To Board After Director Retirement
items.summary: Advanced Micro Devices (NasdaqGS:AMD) appointed Tim Ryan to its Board of Directors, adding new governance experience from his prior roles at Citi and PwC. The appointment follows the retirement of a long serving AMD director and includes related changes to the composition of board committees. Tim Ryan brings decades of background in technology, corporate strategy and risk management that may influence AMD's board oversight and decision making.
